   "source": [
    "This does some crazy math to find the dead center of each grid, in terms of N (x direction from left) and M (y direction from top down), where (0, 0) is the upper left"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "0fd03e41",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def isEmpty(image, location):\n",
    "    pixel = image.getpixel(location)\n",
    "    return all(abs(p - t) <= 10 for p, t in zip(pixel, (31, 37, 70)))\n",
    "\n",
    "def samplePix(image, location):\n",
    "    pixel = image.getpixel(location)\n",
    "    return pixel\n",
    "\n",
    "def isSamePix(image, location, col):\n",
    "    pixel = image.getpixel(location)\n",
    "    return all(abs(p - t) <= 10 for p, t in zip(pixel, col))"
   ]
  },

    "def toCoords(piece):\n",
    "    coords = []\n",
    "    for i in range(6):\n",
    "        for j in range(6):\n",
    "            if (not piece[i, j]):\n",
    "                coords.append((i-2,j-2))\n",
    "    return coords"

   "source": [
    "def canPlaceAt(curGrid, piece, location):\n",
    "    for p in piece:\n",
    "        if location[0]+p[0] < 0 or location[0]+p[0] > 7 or location[1]+p[1] < 0 or location[1]+p[1] > 7:\n",
    "            return False\n",
    "        if not curGrid[location[0]+p[0], location[1]+p[1]]:\n",
    "            return False\n",
    "    return True"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ce4be30e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Goes through ALL possible placements"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 34,
   "id": "4ab24a65",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def allPossiblePlaces(curGrid, piece):\n",
    "    places = [(j-1,i-1) for i in range(9) for j in range(9)\n",
    "              if canPlaceAt(curGrid, piece, (j-1,i-1))]\n",
    "    return places"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "00fae50c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Critical part of Block Blast: The row clears. The Bot will test if a row clear opens up new spots for a future piece in its mind first"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 36,
   "id": "1ef71cce",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def MindClearRow(curGrid):\n",
    "    r = [0]*8\n",
    "    c = [0]*8\n",
    "    for i in range(8):\n",
    "        for j in range(8):\n",
    "            if not curGrid[j, i]:\n",
    "                r[j]+=1\n",
    "                c[i]+=1\n",
    "\n",
    "    clears = 0\n",
    "    for k in range(8):\n",
    "        if c[k] >= 8:\n",
    "            clears+=1\n",
    "            for l in range(8):\n",
    "                curGrid[l, k] = True\n",
    "        if r[k] >= 8:\n",
    "            clears+=1\n",
    "            for l in range(8):\n",
    "                curGrid[k, l] = True\n",
    "    return clears"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 37,
   "id": "0914dc08",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def MindPlaceBlock(curGrid, piece, location):\n",
    "    for p in piece:\n",
    "        curGrid[location[0]+p[0], location[1]+p[1]] = False\n",
    "    return MindClearRow(curGrid)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4891bd93",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Auto Place"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 38,
   "id": "86461f79",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def TryMoves(curPieceId, curGrid, depth=0, moves=[], dir=True, hardPuzzle=False, totalClears=0):\n",
    "    tempMoves = moves.copy()\n",
    "    if (depth >= 3):\n",
    "        return (tempMoves, totalClears)\n",
    "    nestedGrid = np.copy(curGrid)\n",
    "    places = allPossiblePlaces(nestedGrid, pieces[curPieceId])\n",
    "    results = []\n",
    "    anyClear = False\n",
    "    tc = 0\n",
    "    for j in range(len(places)):\n",
    "        tc = totalClears\n",
    "        if (depth==0):\n",
    "            tc = 0\n",
    "        elif (depth==1 and tc >= 1):\n",
    "            tc = 1\n",
    "        elif (depth==2 and tc >= 2):\n",
    "            tc = 2\n",
    "        tempGrid = np.copy(nestedGrid)\n",
    "        newMoves = tempMoves.copy()\n",
    "        newMoves.append((curPieceId, places[j]))\n",
    "        \n",
    "        clears = MindPlaceBlock(tempGrid, pieces[curPieceId], places[j])\n",
    "        if (clears > 0):\n",
    "            tc+=1\n",
    "            anyClear = True\n",
    "        if dir:\n",
    "            sub, tc = TryMoves((curPieceId+1)%3, tempGrid, depth+1, newMoves, True, False, tc)\n",
    "            if sub==[] and depth==0:\n",
    "                sub, clears = TryMoves((curPieceId-1)%3, tempGrid, depth+1, newMoves, False)\n",
    "            if (sub != []):# and (clears > 0 or (j==len(places)-1 and not anyClear) or hardPuzzle)):\n",
    "                results.extend(sub)\n",
    "                if (depth>=2):\n",
    "                    return ([results, tc], tc)\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            sub, tc = TryMoves((curPieceId-1)%3, tempGrid, depth+1, newMoves, False, False, tc)\n",
    "            if (sub != []):# and (clears > 0 or (j==len(places)-1 and not anyClear) or hardPuzzle)):\n",
    "                results.extend(sub)\n",
    "                if (depth>=2):\n",
    "                    return ([results, tc], tc)\n",
    "    return (results, tc)"
   ]
  },

    "def Moves(list):\n",
    "    for i in range(4,-1,-1):\n",
    "        moves = [value for value in list if value[1] >= i]\n",
    "        if (len(moves)>0):\n",
    "            return moves, i\n",
    "    return [], -1"

    "def smoothDrag(start, end, steps=10, duration=0.05):\n",
    "    xs = np.linspace(start[0], end[0], steps)\n",
    "    ys = np.linspace(start[1], end[1], steps)\n",
    "    pau.moveTo(start)\n",
    "    time.sleep(0.05)\n",
    "    pau.mouseDown()\n",
    "    time.sleep(0.05)\n",
    "    for x, y in zip(xs, ys):\n",
    "        pau.moveTo(x, y)\n",
    "        time.sleep(duration/steps)\n",
    "    time.sleep(0.1)\n",
    "    pau.mouseUp()\n",
    "    time.sleep(0.15)"

    "def CoordToGrid(loc, piece):\n",
    "    if (piece == 0):\n",
    "        return (loc[1]*74+52+32+2463+74, (loc[0])*74+52+900+104+19)\n",
    "    elif (piece == 1):\n",
    "        return (loc[1]*74+52+32+2463+118+19, (loc[0])*74+52+900+104+19)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        return (loc[1]*74+52+32+2463+92+104+19, (loc[0])*74+52+900+104+19)"

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "76490b60",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Crazy function that calculates how jagged your piece placement is. This is the biggest strategy improvement I found. It forces the bot to make a bunch of squares on the grid and fill in holes"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 47,
   "id": "a80f0985",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import copy\n",
    "def Density(grid, moves):\n",
    "    test_grid = copy.deepcopy(grid)\n",
    "    for piece_id, pos in moves[0]:           # same loop you had, just unpacked\n",
    "        MindPlaceBlock(test_grid, pieces[piece_id], pos)\n",
    "    rows, cols = len(test_grid), len(test_grid[0])\n",
    "    density_score = 0.0\n",
    "\n",
    "    newGrid = [[0 for x in range(8)] for y in range(8)] \n",
    "\n",
    "    for i in range(rows):\n",
    "        for j in range(cols):\n",
    "            if test_grid[i][j]:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            empty_nbrs   = 0   # how many neighbours are empty\n",
    "            total_nbrs   = 0   # how many neighbours exist for this cell\n",
    "            if i > 0:\n",
    "                total_nbrs += 1\n",
    "                if not test_grid[i-1][j]:\n",
    "                    empty_nbrs += 1\n",
    "            if i < rows-1:\n",
    "                total_nbrs += 1\n",
    "                if not test_grid[i+1][j]:\n",
    "                    empty_nbrs += 1\n",
    "            if j > 0:\n",
    "                total_nbrs += 1\n",
    "                if not test_grid[i][j-1]:\n",
    "                    empty_nbrs += 1\n",
    "            if j < cols-1:\n",
    "                total_nbrs += 1\n",
    "                if not test_grid[i][j+1]:\n",
    "                    empty_nbrs += 1\n",
    "            if total_nbrs:\n",
    "                newGrid[i][j]=int(empty_nbrs*10 / total_nbrs)\n",
    "                density_score += empty_nbrs / total_nbrs\n",
    "\n",
    "    return density_score, newGrid"
   ]
